self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Black Wing (R1): Normal and Charged Attack hits have a 50% chance to trigger a vacuum blade dealing 40% of ATK as AoE DMG (once every 2s max). Modeled as a supplementary hit of 40% ATK — its own rotation target (weapon/normalExtraHit + weapon/chargedExtraHit), weight = how many blades land (the 2s ICD is treated as reliably triggered during sustained combat); physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses. Normal ATK SPD +12% not modeled (non-combat). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: A polearm that symbolizes Dvalin's firm resolve. The upright shaft of this weapon points towards the heavens, clad in the might of sky and wind.

refinements.1: Increases CRIT Rate by <r>8%</r> and increases Normal ATK SPD by <v>12%</v>. Additionally, Normal and Charged Attacks hits on opponents have a <v>50%</v> chance to trigger a vacuum blade that deals <r>40%</r> of ATK as DMG in a small AoE. This effect can occur no more than once every 2s.

fr.flavor: Une lance symbolisant la farouche détermination de Stormterror. Sa hampe se dresse fière vers l'azur, infusée de la volonté des cieux et du pouvoir des vents.
